class: concurrent barrier runs writing one cache file, where one write can lose another's record
caught_by: the cache write holds a lock file naming the writer's pid. A lock whose pid is dead, or older than 60 seconds, is broken with a warning, by moving it aside and dropping it only if it still names the pid judged dead, so a lock taken since that judgement stands; a writer whose lock was broken anyway writes nothing; otherwise the writer retries every 100 ms for up to 30 seconds, then skips the cache write with a warning, and still writes its report and exits with its tiers' status
missed_by: an unlocked read, merge and rename, safe for one writer only, while QA ran its tiers concurrently against one cache

cost.source: not yet measured; first real run
